name: 70445 · Lacombe, LA
findings: ZIP 70445 (Lacombe) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70445 (Lacombe) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
